FEES — PREVIOUS BALANCE / CARRY-OVER

Previous school-fee arrears or credits brought forward

Record previous FEES balance adjustment

Select consecutive academic years: the TO year must be exactly one year after the FROM year. A non-consecutive selection will be rejected. This amount is automatically applied as carry-over into the selected term of the TO year. Positive amount = arrears added to outstanding fees. Negative amount = credit / overpayment deducted from outstanding fees. It is included in the annual summary, student statement and future term/year carry-forwards. Existing payment records and receipts are not changed.

FOOD — PREVIOUS CONTRIBUTION BALANCE / CARRY-OVER

Record food arrears or excess contributions separately from school fees

Record previous FOOD contribution adjustment

The TO year must be exactly one year after the FROM year. Positive quantity means food still owed and increases the food balance. Negative quantity means excess food already contributed and reduces the food balance. This is measured in the selected food item's unit and remains separate from school-fee balances and payments.

Record payment

Food stuffs received

Term-specific food requirements; credits and arrears carry forward automatically

Fee structure

Administrator only · set fees separately for each grade, B/D category, year and term
CLASS-SPECIFIC FEE SETTINGS
The fee amount and additional charges you save apply ONLY to the selected grade, boarding category (B/D), academic year and term. Boarders (B) and Day Scholars (D) have independent fee amounts AND independent annual food contribution requirements. Food quantities are saved separately for each B/D category and carry forward by academic year. Other categories, grades, years and terms will not be changed.

Tick this option if the school collects food contributions. Food quantities are measured in tins and kept separate from KES fees.

Enter the total expected quantity for the FULL ACADEMIC YEAR. Food requirements are saved once per year and are not divided by term. Any outstanding quantity or extra contribution carries forward into the next academic year, item by item.

DANGER ZONE · CLEAR FEES AND FOOD DATA

Permanently clears all saved fee structures, fee payments, opening balances, food requirements and food collection records. Student and teacher records are not affected.

Excel Import — School Fees and Food Collection

Separate, simple templates for money payments and physical food contributions

First select the academic year, class and term. Configure and save a separate fee amount for BOTH relevant B/D categories (Boarder and Day Scholar) for that exact year, class and term in FEE STRUCTURE. The downloaded template includes each learner's B/D code and automatically fills that learner's own configured expected fee. Food quantities are also filled from the matching B/D food structure.

Select the year, class and term, then check that the fee and food requirements have been configured.

After importing the Excel file, generate receipts for every student in that uploaded batch.

Download the correct fees or food template, complete it, select that workbook and click VALIDATE UPLOAD.
